notes.title: V. 1.5 PATCH: New Faces
notes.content:

[list]

notes.title: Vote NOW for the President in Cat President 3!
notes.content:
Every four years, there's a chance for your voice to be heard. Are you happy with the way things are? Are you optimistic for the direction your country is headed?

Or is it time...for a [i]purrlitical revolution[/i]?

That's right! We're in the early (EARLY, EARLY EARLY EARLYEARLYEARLY) stages of planning [i]Cat President 3: Subtitle TBD[/i], and we have an important decision to make:

...Who actually [i]won [/i]the presidency in [i]Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution[/i]? Which pathway is canon? Will it be four more years of President DJ Nibbles, or is it time for some fresh (cat) blood?

We're holding a special election, right here and now, to decide who the canonical president should be in [i]Cat President 3: Do We Even Want "3" in the Title?[/i]. Is it:

- [b]Poopsie IX[/b], the wealthy heir to the presidential throne (and party favorite?)
- [b]Kaleidoscope[/b], the celebri-kitty who once played the President on TV?
- [b]Mr. Biscuits[/b], the single dad who's just here to have fun?
- [b]Earl Grey[/b], the elderstates-cat with something to prove?
- [b]Banders[/b], the political protester turned politician?
- [b]Fe.Line[/b], the robot?

Or is it:

- [b]President DJ Nibbles[/b], the cute incumbent who wears his heart on his tail?

Vote now, by [b]posting your choice in the comments[/b]! In one week, we'll tally up the results and elect the real, official, actually binding canon CAT PRESIDENT.

notes.title: V. 1.1 PATCH: Poor Sad Pup!
notes.content:
*puts down broom* Don't mind me, just sweeping away some bugs!!

- Enabled scroll backward/forward, purr request
- Added a sound effect (courtesy of my dog) to the intro
- Corrected bug with unlocking Earl Grey's normal ending
- Corrected bug where the game resets the default text speed every time you play
- Corrected bug with the way the main character's name is displayed in certain endings
- Removed the lines in Earl Grey's pathway that use the player's OS username for a joke
- Corrected typos

Happy cat-smooching!!
